classifications.derivedLineText: Derived (p.2): A Jab can only flip a ready Guard card to exhausted; it never removes/breaks a Guard card outright.

classifications.derivedLineText: Derived (p.2): A "broken" Guard card is permanently removed from the game (returned to the box), distinct from "exhausted" (flipped face, remains in play and can be flipped back to ready by Rest). Punch can only break an already-exhausted Guard card; against an opponent with no exhausted Guards, Punch instead exhausts one of their ready Guards (same effect as a Jab in that case).
classifications.reason: Every cited fact passed grounding validation (verbatim-traceable to both enumerator lists).

classifications.derivedLineText: Derived (p.2): Resolving a round's Fight phase is two sequential sub-steps — resolve both players' first action cards completely (in timing order), then reveal and resolve both players' second action cards (in timing order) — with cards from the first sub-step staying in place, unresolved into the discard pile, until the Discard phase.
classifications.reason: Every cited fact passed grounding validation (verbatim-traceable to both enumerator lists).

classifications.derivedLineText: Derived (p.2): Win condition: reduce an opponent to 0 Guard cards (all 3 broken) to knock them out and win immediately. If both players' third Guard card is broken by the same action's resolution, the game ends in a draw instead of a win.
